sentences.text: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: EPF Reimbursement to MSMEs

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs" aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports.
**Who is this for:** Business Entity, Industries; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for MSMEs&quot; is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat. It aims to empower the state&#39;s dynamic MSME sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports. Effective from October 5, 2022, to October 4, 2027, this initiative supports growth, investments, and the vision of &quot;Aatmanirbhar Gujarat&quot; and &quot;Aatmanirbhar Bharat.&quot; The component &quot;Financial Support to MSMEs in ZED Certification&quot; provides reimbursement of the employer&#39;s statutory contribution under the Employees&#39; Provident Fund (EPF) to eligible MSMEs for their new employees in Gujarat. <br>

**Benefits / Assistance:** 1. **100% Reimbursement:** Covers 100% of the employer’s statutory EPF contribution for new employees. 1. **Maximum Limit:** Reimbursement capped at 12% of basic salary plus Dearness Allowance (DA) or ₹1800 per employee per month, whichever is lower. 1. **Extended Support:** Assistance is available for up to 10 years from the date of commercial production.

**Exclusions / Not eligible:** - MSMEs that have availed EPF reimbursement under any scheme of the central/state government, or any agency of the central/ state government, shall not be eligible for EPF reimbursement under this scheme for that period. <br>

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "New Investor Registration" to access the registration form. **Step 2:** Fill in the Registration Form. Click on "Submit". **Step 3:** Verify the E-mail ID using the link sent on your registered E-mail ID. **Step 4:** After verification, you will be registered successfully.  > **Post-Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "Login". **Step 2:** Enter the email address and password you used during registration. **Step 3:** Click the "Login" button to access your account. **Step 4:** Now fill in the required details and mandatory documents about your business to complete the application process.  > **Helpdesk:** [Contact Here.](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/IFP-pages/contact.jsp?pagedisp=static)
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Industries and Mines Department
